description: The growth rate of Collatz trajectories is governed by ln(3)/ln(2). Angeltveit uses the rational approximation 485/306 > ln(3)/ln(2) to derive an exact integer criterion: if 485*f <= 306*k then T^k(n) < n for n > 99781. This converts floating-point comparisons into exact integer arithmetic, critical for GPU correctness.
analogical_connections: Continued fraction approximation in Diophantine analysis
Lyapunov exponent estimation in dynamical systems
implementation_hypothesis: Replace all floating-point comparisons with the integer test 485*f_count <= 306*step_count. Precompute dip values for bitvectors. Maintain running counts during Step 3 iteration.
experiment_seed: Compare tightness of 485/306 against higher convergents. Measure false-positive rate and computational cost of tighter bounds.
